meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 当你要求重构代码时，Claude 会先分析你的意图和整个代码库，然后分阶段进行：绘制依赖图、评估测试覆盖、生成详细计划、逐步执行重构并在每次更改后自动测试，确保没有破坏任何功能。
howto.when: 当你说“重构”、“清理”等关键词，或使用 /refactor 命令时触发。

say.text: 把这个函数提取到新模块
say.note: 触发 extract 模式，Claude 会分析并移动代码。

say.text: 重构 auth 模块，用安全策略
清理所有弃用 API 的调用
say.note: 触发 cleanup，Claude 会替换为推荐 API。

howto.what_en: When you ask to refactor code, Claude will first analyze your intent and the entire codebase, then proceed in phases: build dependency graph, assess test coverage, generate detailed plan, execute refactoring step by step, and run tests after each change to ensure no regressions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say keywords like 'refactor', 'cleanup', etc., or use the /refactor command.

say_en.text: Extract this function to a new module
say_en.note: Triggers extract mode; Claude analyzes and moves code.

say_en.text: Refactor auth module with safe strategy
say_en.note: Specifies scope and strategy; Claude executes plan.

say_en.text: Clean up all deprecated API calls
say_en.note: Triggers cleanup; Claude replaces with recommended APIs.
